items.label: 【New Upgraded Model】
items.value: We have improved the overall structure of the trellis on the original base to avoid the problem of loosening and falling apart, and added new anti-slip spikes to make it easier for your plants to climb and grow.

items.label: 【Rustproof and Durable】
items.value: Our garden trellis is made of thickened steel tubes wrapped with PE coating, which can effectively reduce the high temperature on the surface of the iron pipe and protect the plants. It is also waterproof and rustproof, which prolongs the service life.

items.label: 【Widening Width】
items.value: 47.2" high x 35.4" wide garden trellis fence, provides more spacious climbing space, the grid structure in the middle allows sunlight and air to pass through better, promotes plant photosynthesis and ventilation, and helps plants grow healthy.

items.label: 【Simple DIY】
items.value: You can easily create a "plant hedge" or "flower wall" using 2 or more trellis,or you can take them apart and use them individually as climbing supports for potted plants.

items.label: 【Beautiful and Practical】
items.value: The decorative Garden Fence is not only practical but also adds beauty to your garden. It is beautifully designed and can be combined with a variety of flowers and horticultural elements to create a unique and striking garden landscape. It is ideal for indoor potted plants, vines, trellises, cucumbers, tomato cages, peas, jasmine, and other plants.
